decision.description: go: full pipeline. no-go: rejected with evidence. triage-trial: security-boundary escape hatch — property pipeline on encodable subset, findings decide.

decision_basis.description: Why the decision holds. admission_conditions: at least one of the three conditions is met. grandfathered: pre-gate corpus already admitted and running. escape_hatch: security-boundary triage trial. Required when decision=go with zero conditions met.

fraction_decision.description: Post-extraction encodable-fraction outcome (>= 0.30 gate), when it differs from the admission decision. The fraction gate is sequential and separate: admission decides whether to extract, fraction decides whether the result is usable. Recorded here for convenience; the authoritative fraction artifact is <corpus>_encodable_fraction.json / phase3_decision_matrix.json.

flags.description: Counts per flag/construct surface: (?x), (?i), (?s), (?m), \K, \g{, POSIX classes, lookarounds, backrefs, wide/ascii, ...

predicted_buckets.description: Predicted reject-bucket overlap using the probe prediction-vocabulary artifact (construct → bucket map; P1 task 0 / umbrella C5). Not equal to live inventory compile_reason cardinality (57+ distinct reasons at design-review). Historical 17/22/21 figures are stale snapshots.

escape_hatch_applied.description: True when the security-boundary findings-triage trial was invoked despite failing scale/surface conditions.

related.description: Cross-refs: prior no-go candidates, nearest admitted corpus in the same dialect (name + fraction), sweep/ docs.

allOf.description: decision=go requires a defensible basis: at least one condition met, or an explicit grandfathered/escape-hatch basis.
grandfathered requires provenance: the artifact must declare related.backfilled=true (pre-gate corpus, decision predates the gate). A fresh probe cannot claim grandfathered.
escape_hatch requires a security-boundary triage path: security-boundary condition met AND escape_hatch_applied=true. A non-security corpus cannot declare the hatch.
triage-trial is the security-boundary findings trial: it requires the security-boundary condition met and escape_hatch_applied=true, matching the documented lifecycle.
decision=no-go with any admission condition met is a contradiction: per the plan, any-one-passes => GO. The fraction gate outcome belongs in fraction_decision, never in decision.

A fresh (non-grandfathered) GO or TRIAGE-TRIAL decision must carry real evidence: at least one regex site. NO-GO decisions are exempt — zero regex sites is itself a valid rejection reason (no regex surface to scan).
